title: Danger Building Worker (DBW) on Tenure Basis
age_limit: Between 18 and 40 years as on the closing date of receipt of application

important_dates.label: Online Application Deadline
important_dates.date: 21 days from the date of publication of advertisement in Employment News

summary: Ordnance Factory Badmal invites offline applications from eligible Indian citizens for engagement as Danger Building Worker (DBW) on a tenure basis for one year, extendable up to four years. There are a total of 70 vacancies available for candidates possessing NCVT/NAC certification in AOCP or other feeder trades. Selection will be based on marks secured in the NCVT exam and a trade/practical test.
eligibility_bullets: Minimum age 18 years and maximum 40 years as on the closing date of application, with relaxations for reserved categories as per rules.
Must possess National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) / National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) certificate in AOCP or recognized feeder trades.
how_to_apply_steps: Download and print the application form from the official website.
Fill in all details in BLOCK LETTERS and attach self-attested copies of required educational, caste, and experience certificates.
Affix a recent passport size self-attested photograph on the application and include one extra self-attested photograph with name and date of birth written on the backside.
Superscribe the envelope with "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF TENURE BASED DBW ON CONTRACT BASIS".
Send the completed application by post to The Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Badmal, PO - Badmal, District - Balangir, Pin - 767070, ODISHA.
